messages.subject: Ashby House, Curzon Street — instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up on Friday. We've agreed heads on Ashby House, 40 Curzon Street W1 at £24.75m and would like Whitfield Carter to act on the acquisition. Westmoreland are the sellers; their solicitors are Pendle Voss. Target is to exchange by end of April and complete mid-May.

Can you send through your engagement letter and let me know what you need from us to get going?

Daniel

messages.subject: RE: Ashby House, Curzon Street — instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Delighted to act. My engagement letter is attached — please sign and return the copy. James Osei (senior associate) will run the day-to-day and Elena Marchetti will take title and lease review.

To get going we'll need: (1) confirmation of the acquiring entity (the company or an SPV), (2) source of funds for the deposit and balance, and (3) your VAT registration details so we can deal with the option to tax / TOGC. I'll request the data-room access from Pendle Voss today.

SDLT will be £1,227,000 on £24.75m and is payable within 14 days of completion — worth factoring into the funding.

Best,
Sarah
